tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge with no border, frame, letterbox band or matte of any kind. The brushed-aluminium lid stays whole — seamed rim, domed centre, rivet and ring pull-tab in place — only the narrow scored slot beside the tab cracked open. The jet leaves through that slot alone, a column of cloudy pale-yellow yuzu soda threaded with fine carbonation, clean for two hand-widths then fanning, every droplet on one arc off the slot, sizes falling away along it. The citrus-green stripe stays one unbroken horizontal band where the water track crosses it; condensation reads as discrete separated beads with bare matte coat between them. 85mm at f/11 at can height on a saturated citrus-green seamless, hard flash from camera-left freezing the fan, no daylight in the room, a white bounce at camera-right holding the flank to its reference pale cream-yellow, not the ground's green. The rolled base sits flat with a hard contact shadow directly beneath it, no gap; the can holds half the frame height, green runs unbroken to the bottom edge, spray cuts the top.
